Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the invoice. Sorry for the confusion, we'll get this sorted quickly. I am looping in Marcus from Billing so he can review the invoice and the account record.

Quick answers up front:
- Trial/PLG credits should apply automatically to usage charges; you should not be billed until credits exhaust or billing is enabled.
- VAT handling depends on whether you provided a valid EU VAT ID and how your account was set up.

Marcus — could you take a look at invoice_20261005.pdf and confirm whether this was charged in error and if we can issue a credit? Also, please advise on next steps for VAT exemption (we may need their VAT ID).

I expect the credit to appear on your payment portal in the next 24 hours; please let me know if your finance team needs a formal amendment or a tax exemption certificate from our side.
